name: agent-skills
description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
one_liner: A set of packaged checklists and slash commands that make an AI coding assistant follow the same discipline a senior engineer would, from writing a spec to shipping.
buyer: An engineering manager at a small startup who wants their AI-assisted team to stop shipping messy, untested code without hiring a dedicated tech lead.
business_use_cases: A dev agency installs it across every client project so junior contractors' AI-generated code meets a consistent quality bar.
A coding bootcamp uses it to teach students what 'production-grade' actually looks like by having them follow the same commands professionals use.
An engineering consultancy sells 'AI development process audits' where they check whether a client's team is using disciplined workflows like this one.

money_ideas.idea: Custom skill packs tailored to a specific company's stack and conventions, sold as a one-time setup fee.
A paid 'skills marketplace' curation and support subscription for teams that want vetted, maintained skill packs.

steal_this: This is a tool developers use on themselves, not something you resell directly. The realistic weekend project is a short paid workshop teaching teams how to install and customize it for their codebase.
